# BRAssetEncode.h and BRAssetSendPlan.h vectors: the headers' answers, written down. Generated by
# vectors/asset-send-plan/generate.c, which describes each field; do not edit (asset_send_plan_kat
# checks it). One vector a line, fields separated by one space, numbers in decimal. No line occurs
# twice. A is the asset sent, O another. Rows: <txid>:<vout>:<script hex or .>:<sats>:<quantity>
# joined by '/' (a plain row in choose adds y/n/u: its creating transaction has a data output).
# encode <version> <flags:output:amount,...|-> <script hex | refused why>
# fee <assetInputs> <dgbInputs> <outputs> <opReturnBytes> <feePerKb> <fee | overflow>
# select <assetRows> <dgbRows> <need> <fee> <marker> <changeMarker>
#   <ok a d change dgbChange | insufficient-asset r a | insufficient-dgb r a | refused | overflow>
# plan <assetRows> <dgbRows> <quantity> <feePerKb> <ready a d role:sats,... carrier est paid | refused why [numbers]>
# judge <lookup> <entries> <recordedQuantity> <verified | mismatch | unavailable>
# groups <rows> <quantity> <first:rowCount:total,...|-> <largest>
# choose <world> <call> <rule> <indexer> <assetRows> <dgbRows> <stacks> <quantity> <feePerKb> <answer> <asks>
# parse <text hex|-> <divisibility> <units | null>
# format <units> <divisibility> <text>
